items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: We went there to see him once.

ctx.x: And there were several other people. And out in the bar, after the show would be over, we would do our thing and then somebody else would do this, or comedy, whatever, a lot of things were happening. Out in the bar this wonderful, exciting piano player, Bobby Short.
Honey, I have to correct you. That isn’t true.
Well I wish you hadn’t said that.
